item.title: Fixing a hole (part 2)
item.description: The shed was made from scrap material off a job site. After about 20 years, it needed a new roof. The first design had the end of the rafter meet the edge of the wall, water shot right off the end, some into the grass below, some onto the edge. The problem with this after 20 years was the water seeped behind the exterior panels, causing them to swell. Alright the other problem, California Ground Squirrels, these bastards have been burrowing under the slab of the shed, causing it to sink, along with the shed also sinking.
